evidence.why: Client directly authenticates to the vendor payment API using an API key held in client-side memory, instead of routing through the developer's own backend.
A vendor API key literal/placeholder is embedded directly in client application code, confirming a client-side credential slot exists.

other_classes_observed: WebView configured with originWhitelist=['*'], allowFileAccess=true, mixedContentMode='always' which is risky WebView configuration
Payment success state is driven by client-parsed WebView messages/URL params rather than a server-verified receipt
